name: Rosewood Miyakojima
insider_take: This ultra-luxury resort sits on pristine Miyakojima Island, where crystal-clear waters rival the Maldives and traditional Ryukyu culture meets contemporary elegance.
whats_special: Miyakojima boasts some of Japan's most stunning coral reefs and is home to the famous Yonaha Maehama Beach, consistently ranked among Asia's best beaches. The island's unique position creates a microclimate with over 300 sunny days per year, and it's one of the few places in Japan where you can witness the rare "green flash" sunset phenomenon.
pro_tip: Visit during late spring (April-May) for perfect weather and to witness the spectacular blooming of the island's native bougainvillea and hibiscus without the summer crowds.
dont_miss: Snorkeling at Aragusuku Beach to see tropical fish in crystal-clear waters, exploring the mystical Pumya limestone caves, and experiencing a traditional Okinawan cooking class featuring the island's famous purple sweet potatoes and Miyako beef.
pros: Ultra-luxury beachfront resort with pristine private beaches
Spacious villas with private pools and ocean views
Exceptional dining experiences featuring local Okinawan cuisine
cons: Remote island location requires flight connections
